latency.inference: n20 each arm/cell, 10 balanced four-process blocks. Bootstrap intervals resample block mean differences, on minus off; descriptive p95 at n20 is not a p99/tail guarantee. Multiple metrics, no multiplicity correction. All failures/outliers kept; no replacements. Positive isolated diagnostics checked. Long sessions/memory separately assessed.

longAndMemory.limits: Fallback n20 each arm/variant. Long ordinary latency n3 each arm/case; retirement p95/max descriptive over actual epochs returned in ordinary completion data. Sampled memory 20ms may miss peaks and family RSS double-counts shared pages; short n3 and long n1 per arm. Budget-exceeded runs retained. No unlimited-session or arbitrary-workload RSS guarantee.

limitations: Fresh processes and warm filesystem; no cache flush, CPU pinning or frequency control; other apps not stopped.
No builds, tests or RSS sampling concurrent with ordinary latency measurements. Memory is a separate instrumented replay.
n20 each ordinary short cell, paired balanced block inference; n3 long latency, n3 short memory, n1 long memory. p95/max are descriptive, not tail guarantees.
Native W12 UTF16 query issue predates the candidate and is excluded; negotiated UTF8 and CRLF alternatives are included.
Independent diagnostic workers continue full native parsing; default-off correctness matches original Native, but timing compares Config off/on in current binary.
Local educational SPI/PSS plus official UVM 1.2 UBUS are not production designs; no simulation, GUI editor or new Linux acceptance.
The 20ms RSS sampler can miss peaks; process-family sums count shared pages repeatedly; threshold bounds source generations, not arbitrary process RSS.
Completion memory sessions resolve only the selected item; every-candidate resolve latency is separately measured and is not an RSS measurement of the fully populated resolver cache.
Project source files and complete oracle response bodies stay local. Archived drivers require the original local fixture layout and private workload specifications.

No cross-process or on-disk serialization implemented; old prototype/old retirement measurements are retained separately and do not establish final-candidate performance. Earlier long-memory scripts did not record an explicit last-step RSS mark; final-candidate measurements fix that marker.
